build_maskformer_model: build a MaskFormer panoptic segmentation model with ResNet50 backbone and 100 queries for COCO dataset
configure_data_preprocessor: configure DetDataPreprocessor with RGB conversion, padding, and normalization for image segmentation inputs
setup_training_pipeline: setup a training pipeline with random flip, multi-scale resize, and random crop for panoptic annotation loading
configure_optimizer_scheduler: configure AdamW optimizer with learning rate scheduling and gradient clipping for 75-epoch training
run_panoptic_evaluation: run panoptic segmentation evaluation with Hungarian assignment and fused mask scoring on COCO dataset
